cards.title: Deep Research Note: Post-Quantum Cryptography Gaps in Zscaler and a Multi-Vendor ZTNA Pitch for Banks (Oct 2025)
cards.key_problem: Banks migrating to post-quantum cryptography cannot rely on Zscaler alone: as of October 2025 Zscaler can only report PQC usage, not decrypt and inspect PQC-encrypted traffic, and its cloud-routed model worries banks on latency, ATM / branch resilience and data residency.
key_outcomes: Zscaler PQC roadmap as of Oct 2025: phase 1 visibility reporting (X25519MLKEM768 detection) live; phase 2 PQC TLS inspection in development; phase 3 PQC signatures future

Recommended hybrid: Zscaler ZIA for internet / SaaS, ZPA for ordinary private apps, Accops ZTNA in parallel for ATM / branch links, core banking, payment gateways and legacy apps needing quantum-safe wrapping now
Cites TEC 910018 (2025) guidance to use quantum-safe VPN tunnels during PQC migration
Multi-vendor rationale: third-party / single-vendor risk, regulator vendor-tiering, ZIA/ZPA two-console complexity, cloud dependency for ATMs, sub-10 ms latency needs
Positioning line: 'not replacement, but strategic augmentation'; use-case table Zscaler vs Accops ZTNA (quantum-enabled)
cards.brief: An AI-assisted 'deep research' note from October 2025 prepared for a bank presentation. It summarises Zscaler's published post-quantum cryptography posture (visibility and reporting only, inspection and signatures still on the roadmap) and the resulting blind spot for banks that must inspect TLS traffic. It then proposes positioning Accops ZTNA as complementary to Zscaler rather than a replacement: quantum-wrapped tunnels for ATM and branch networks, core banking and payment gateways, legacy apps and local Indian deployment for data residency, citing India's TEC PQC migration report. Further sections cover why banks adopt multi-vendor SSE / ZTNA, Zscaler's general weaknesses (logging, cloud dependency, separate consoles, a client-connector configuration decryption finding), and competitors (Palo Alto Prisma Access, Netskope, Appgate, Cloudbrink). Sources are listed and include vendor blogs, Reddit threads and market-research sites.
cards.use_for: Internal preparation for a bank or financial-services deal where Zscaler is the incumbent and the CISO is asking about post-quantum readiness; gives the 'augment, don't replace' framing and ATM / branch use case. Not a customer document.
cards.stale_risk: A snapshot of Zscaler's PQC roadmap as of October 2025 - Zscaler may have shipped phase 2 since. The note is machine-generated research: some sources are Reddit threads and blogs, and statements such as 'Accops provides PQC wrapping today' are the note's claims, not verified product documentation. Confirm HySecure's actual PQC capability (the HySecure datasheets mention quantum-safe algorithms) before quoting.
cards.internal_reason: Internal research note with unverified claims about a named competitor; not for customers.
cards.needs_human: Product team should confirm which PQC algorithms HySecure ships today before this positioning is used with a bank.
